correctness.rationale: Conditional expectation shows E[x_{k+1}e_{k+1}]=E[e_{k+1}^2] for all k, yielding an exact two-dimensional moments recurrence after one step. Symbolically checked trace, determinant, and 3 Jury polynomials imply sufficiency at p>1/2 and 0<h<(4p-2)/(3-2p). Outside, strictly positive moment transition and initial moments for 0<p<1 give a positive Perron mode of modulus at least one; the positive off-diagonal coupling means x second moment cannot decay. p=1 follows deterministic GD. The memoryless comparison is direct. Proof handles all boundaries. Standalone exact checker passed 365 assertions; finite checks do not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural inverse-p-amplified unbiased sparse compressor has qualitatively different exact stability from memoryless use. The sharp universal p=1/2 cutoff eliminates all fixed-step mean-square convergence despite strictly positive stable range for the no-memory comparator. This complete natural parameter classification gives a concrete design boundary rather than an arbitrary numeric slice, and identifies precisely which residual mechanism is unsafe.
